hook: Why the server, not the browser, owns the match clock
text:
Why the server, not the browser, owns the match clock

A browser can pause or reconnect. The server keeps the authoritative match state and validates each move.

That makes reconnect and timing behavior easier to audit.

#TelegramMiniApp #WebSockets #BuildInPublic
